Game Overview

City Traffic Control puts players into a management experience centered on become a master traffic orchestrator in City Traffic Control. Navigate a bustling cityscape, directing vehicles with unique traits. Strategize to prevent collisions and ensure prompt deliveries. Your swift decisions earn points, while clever maneuvers keep traffic flowing smoothly in this dynamic and immersive urban environment.
